description:
File a patient safety incident report in HospitalRun. 

Scenario: You are a charge nurse and need to document a patient fall that occurred earlier.

1. Navigate to the 'Incidents' section.
2. Create a new incident report.
3. Fill in the following details:
   - Department: Hospital
   - Date of Incident: 01/15/2025
   - Reported To: Dr. James Chen
   - Category: Patient Fall (or similar 'Fall' category)
   - Patient: Maria Santos (Search and select the existing patient)
   - Description: 'Patient found on floor beside bed at 0230 after attempting to reach bathroom unassisted. No visible injuries noted on assessment. Patient alert and oriented x4. Vital signs stable - BP 128/78, HR 82, RR 16, SpO2 97% on room air. Bed alarm was activated but patient had removed wrist band prior to ambulation attempt. Attending physician Dr. Chen notified at 0245 and came to assess. Fall risk reassessment completed - upgraded to high fall risk. One-to-one sitter ordered for remainder of admission. Incident occurred in room 412B.'
   - Harm/Sentinel Event: No
4. Save the incident report.
